Universal ATX Power Supply Tester
Dr. Power III Pro supports all modern ATX power supplies up to ATX12V v3.1 with full PCIe 12+4-pin connector compatibility and SENSE0/SENSE1 detection. The clear LCD display makes reading and interpreting voltage output results simple and intuitive for system builders repair professionals and DIY techs.
Real-Time Voltage LCD Display
Dr. Power III Pro delivers real time voltage display for +12V, +5V, +3.3V, and +5Vsb output rails. The clear LCD screen lets users read and understand voltage output data at a glance making power supply diagnostics simple intuitive and reliable for builders repair professionals and DIY techs.
Precision in PCIe 12+4pin Connector Detection
Dr. Power III Pro detects SENSE0/SENSE1 sideband signals on the PCIe 12+4-pin connector and identifies power levels of 150W, 300W, 450W, and 600W making it compatible with modern PCIe Gen 5.1 graphics cards and components.
Flexible Testing Modes
Dr. Power III Pro offers manual and automatic testing modes so that users can choose the method that best fits their needs. Users can either test each power connector one by one or run a full automated check to quickly determine the status of the power supply output.
Built-in Diagnostic System with Enhanced Alert for Pro Use
The colored segmented display on Dr. Power III Pro shows voltage output and diagnostic status at a glance. Faults trigger a warning icon plus an audible beep alert to warn the user.
Long-Term Assurance with a 3-Year Warranty
We stand behind the reliability of Dr. Power III Pro and offer a three year warranty to guarantee long lasting quality and performance.
